instruction: I've received a request from my friend who asked for assistance in editing an image. The document with the requirements and the picture to be adjusted are on the Desktop. Please resize the image to 800x600 pixels and save the edited picture as "pic.jpg" on the Desktop. Thank you!

metadata.explanation: Task requires resizing image to 800x600 pixels. Created custom metric check_image_resize__89f19527 to verify the output image dimensions.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both requirements: image dimensions (800x600) and file location (/home/user/Desktop/pic.jpg)
Getter extracts the correct state: fetches the output file from the specified Desktop location
Metric logic is correct: uses PIL to extract image dimensions and compares with expected values
Expected values are semantically correct: target_width=800 and target_height=600 match instruction exactly
Data flow is sound: vm_file getter -> PIL image dimension extraction -> exact comparison -> binary score
Error handling is present: returns 0.0 on exceptions or missing data
Postconfig includes 1-second sleep to allow file operations to complete
